scope: Synthetic durable notebook exchanges through InMemorySyncTransport. No CloudKit, network latency, real app data, debounce, background scheduling, rendering, or editor flush. Markdown publication measured separately.
method: Three sequential repetitions per case, Release, warm filesystem caches. No concurrent local builds or test suites during either run.
